landing.title: Hear from your guests, right at the counter
landing.lead: Put one QR code on the table and guests leave questions and feedback anonymously. Answer only the ones you want.
landing.how1: Sign up with your email and shop name to get your link and QR code instantly.
landing.how2: Save the QR and place it on tables, the counter or the door.
landing.how3: Answer what you want to answer. Hide or delete the rest.
landing.sampleQ: Do you sell the decaf beans too?
landing.sampleA: Yes, in 200g bags. Just ask at the counter.
landing.faq1a: Yes. Signing up, receiving questions, answering and the QR code are all free. Guests may see ads.
landing.faq2q: Can I see who wrote a question?
landing.faq2a: No. Guests don't sign up, and no name, contact or IP address is kept.
landing.faq3a: Common slurs are blocked automatically, and you can hide, delete or block. Posts reported by several people are hidden right away.
landing.faq4q: If I rename my shop, do I need a new QR?
landing.faq4a: No. Your link and QR code never change.
landing.closing: Sign up today, put it on the tables tomorrow.

reset.sent: If that email is registered, we've sent a message. Check your inbox and spam folder.

share.desc: Your link and QR code never change. Put them up once and keep using them.

share.qrCaption: Scan to leave an anonymous question

settings.title: Settings
settings.introHint: Shown under the name. e.g. Open from 10 on weekends
settings.showUnansweredOn: Guests can see questions you haven't answered yet.
settings.wordsDesc: Questions containing these words can't be posted. Add staff names or other shops' names. Guests don't see this list, but don't put secrets in it.
settings.deleteDesc: All questions and replies are erased and can't be recovered. Your link and QR stop working and are never given to another shop.
